aboutpara: I design social media, web, outdoor and print visuals, and I'm most passionate about user-centered digital design. My work is guided by consistency, accessibility and simplicity: I put stakeholder requirements and user needs first while keeping designs clean and aesthetic. A strong corporate background in sales and procurement helps me understand the business behind every brief.

about.tagline: Graphic & UI/UX Designer, backed by a strong corporate business background

sections.label: Professional Summary
sections.title: Graphic Designer & UI/UX Designer
sections.body: I'm a Graphic and UI/UX Designer based in Sofia, creating social media, web, outdoor and print visuals. My passion is user-centered digital design: from color, typography and iconography to responsive layouts, interactive prototypes and design systems in Figma. I combine hands-on design in Figma, Illustrator and Photoshop with AI tools where they help me move faster on concepts, imagery and video. Before design, I worked in procurement at IBM and sales at Cisco, which taught me to understand stakeholders, business requirements and deadlines.

sections.label: Design Philosophy
sections.title: Consistency, Accessibility, Simplicity
sections.body: Focused on consistency, accessibility, and simplicity. I prioritize stakeholder requirements and user needs while incorporating clean and aesthetic designs.

sections.label: Artistic Foundation
sections.title: From Traditional Art to Digital Design
sections.body: My journey as a designer began in early childhood, when I developed a passion for drawing and painting landscapes, flowers, animals, and portraits. Ever since my childhood I used to draw continuously with aquarelle, oil and acrylic colors. This artistic personality gives me a natural advantage in UI design, particularly in creating original and beautiful visual elements and understanding color theory and composition. Today, I continue to develop these skills digitally using my Wacom tablet with Adobe Illustrator, bringing the freedom of drawing art on paper to digital design.
